source.label: Placed in M31 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 771,340 pc (src/objects/m31-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 776,247 pc from the Local Volume Database v1.1.1 (Pace 2025), inclination 74 deg, line of nodes 37.7 deg). The galaxy's Cepheid distance, Li et al. (2021), ApJ 920, 84, abstract: modulus 24.407 +/- 0.032 mag, 761 kpc; it places the galaxy, not a star within it

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,080 K and log g 0.8 (u1 0.603, u2 0.148): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

controls.label: Pulsation
controls.qualification: Gaia DR3 fitted light curve · maximum light
controls.notes: DIRECT V5614 M31A at maximum light, phase 0.0 of one 20.2-day pulsation: its color dimmed to 100% of its light at maximum, as Gaia DR3's published G-band model of the star gives it. The 10 steps are a tenth of a period apart (a display choice); the model between them is continuous. The star's color and size also change through the cycle and are not drawn: nothing here measures them.
